define <2 x i32> @test_pasubu_w(<2 x i32> %a, <2 x i32> %b) {
  %a_ext = zext <2 x i32> %a to <2 x i64>
  %b_ext = zext <2 x i32> %b to <2 x i64>
  %sub = sub <2 x i64> %a_ext, %b_ext
  %res = lshr <2 x i64> %sub, splat (i64 1)
  %res_trunc = trunc <2 x i64> %res to <2 x i32>
  ret <2 x i32> %res_trunc
}

define <4 x i16> @wide_zext_v4i16(<4 x i16> %a, <4 x i16> %b) {
  %x = zext <4 x i16> %a to <4 x i32>
  %y = zext <4 x i16> %b to <4 x i32>
  %d = sub <4 x i32> %x, %y
  %s = lshr <4 x i32> %d, splat (i32 1)
  %r = trunc <4 x i32> %s to <4 x i16>
  ret <4 x i16> %r
}

declare void @throw_exception()

declare i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

declare ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr)

declare void @__cxa_end_catch()

define void @test1() personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  invoke void @throw_exception()
          to label %try.cont unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          catch ptr null
  %1 = extractvalue { ptr, i32 } %0, 0
  %2 = tail call ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr %1)
  tail call void @__cxa_end_catch()
  br label %try.cont

try.cont:                                         ; preds = %lpad, %entry
  ret void
}

}

@var = external global [30 x i64]
@G = external global i32

define graalcc void @keep_live() {
  %LGV = load i32, ptr @G, align 4
  %B = shl i32 %LGV, -1
  %A = alloca [30 x i64], align 8
  store [30 x i64] poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %val = load volatile [30 x i64], ptr @var, align 4
  %I = insertvalue [30 x i64] %val, i64 1, 25
  store volatile [30 x i64] %val, ptr @var, align 4
  store [30 x i64] %I, ptr %A, align 4
  store i32 %B, ptr %A, align 4
  ret void
}

@G = external global i128

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @lshr_16bytes_wordOff(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %wordOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %LGV = load i128, ptr @G, align 4
  %src = load i128, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %wordOff = load i128, ptr %wordOff.ptr, align 1
  %bitOff = shl i128 %wordOff, 5
  %C = icmp eq i128 %wordOff, %LGV
  %res = lshr i128 %src, %bitOff
  store i128 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i1 %C, ptr poison, align 1
  ret void
}
